cases.given: Legal constraints must inform but not be rewritten by the creative mode.
cases.expect: Creative copy respects cited constraints without domain-rule leakage.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: System and task authority outrank domain-local preferences.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Pause when the domain is ambiguous and different classifications change safety or authority.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.expect: Keep rules partitioned and project only the verified fact with provenance.
